expected_facts: PyFunc class imports all symbols inside the class cell
Builds test payload using real Ensembl gene IDs from vocab.txt
Sends inference controls in the REST body under "params" (SDK extra_params are dropped by the scoring server)
Purges teddy.* from sys.modules before load_context
guidelines: Single notebook with restartPython() boundaries is acceptable (CPU download + GPU register/deploy phases)
Must not download weights at request time
Must not invent gene IDs or tensor shapes
Must use AI Gateway for inference table logging
Must register model with signature + input_example

download_staging/uses_tmp.why: Download/staging must go to /tmp; /local_disk0 is not available on serverless, so the download step fails there.
download_staging/uses_tmp.assumes: serverless GPU notebook compute, AI Runtime v5 (eval/README_environments.md)

download_staging/hf_xet_disabled.why: The TEDDY Hugging Face repo uses the Xet/CAS backend; without HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET the download fails (CAS service error).
download_staging/hf_xet_disabled.assumes: Merck/TEDDY repo on Xet storage; AI Runtime pre-enables hf_transfer (teddy.md:137)

download_staging/deps_pinned.why: transformers 5.x breaks TeddyGModel (all_tied_weights_keys); an unpinned spec resolves to 5.x in the serving container.

pyfunc_quality/pyfunc_class.why: TEDDY is served through a custom PyFunc wrapper; without one there is nothing to serve.

pyfunc_quality/imports_inside_class.why: The serving container loads the class in a fresh process; symbols imported only at notebook level are missing there.

pyfunc_quality/load_context.why: Weights, tokenizer and code bundle are loaded in load_context; without it predict has no model.

pyfunc_quality/sys_modules_purge.why: Robustness on out-of-order re-runs in a long-lived kernel.

pyfunc_quality/io_stringio.why: pandas 2.1+ deprecates literal JSON strings in read_json; a warning today.

pyfunc_quality/artifacts_declared.why: Weights and the code bundle reach the serving container only as declared artifacts / code_paths.

pyfunc_quality/real_gene_ids.why: Synthetic gene names map to <unk> and give degenerate embeddings, so the validation cannot catch a broken tokenisation path.

model_registration/infer_signature.why: Unity Catalog registration requires a model signature; the serving contract is defined by it.

model_registration/input_example.why: Without an input example the signature and test payloads are not grounded in a real request.

model_registration/pip_requirements.why: The serving container installs only what is declared; TEDDY needs torch/transformers/numpy/pandas pins.

model_registration/pip_reqs_from_source.why: Documents where the pins came from.

endpoint_deployment/sdk_enums.why: A string workload_type breaks ServedEntityInput.as_dict (it calls .value) in the Python SDK, so endpoint creation fails.

endpoint_deployment/ai_gateway_config.why: No inference table: requests and responses are not logged or governed.

endpoint_deployment/run_go_gate.why: Guards expensive cells in shared notebooks.

smoke_tests/registration_smoke.why: The registered model is never loaded and called before serving, so a broken registration is found only at deploy time.

smoke_tests/endpoint_query.why: The endpoint is never queried, so a broken deployment goes unnoticed.

smoke_tests/output_shape_check.why: Embedding size is never checked against config.d_model, so wrong or mixed embeddings go unnoticed.

forbidden_patterns/local_disk0.assumes: serverless GPU notebook compute, AI Runtime v5 (eval/README_environments.md)

forbidden_patterns/transformers.why: transformers>= resolves to 5.x and breaks TeddyGModel.

forbidden_patterns/ENSG00000FAKE.why: Invented gene IDs give degenerate embeddings in validation.

forbidden_patterns/AutoCaptureConfigInpu.why: The legacy auto-capture API is rejected (recorded: models/teddy/runs_20260924/results/baseline/oss-002.txt:1169, 'auto_capture deprecated'), so endpoint creation with it fails.

forbidden_patterns/workload_type_GPU.why: String workload_type breaks ServedEntityInput.as_dict, so endpoint creation fails.

edge_handling.why: Not applicable to TEDDY tasks (always passes).

new_checks/ai_gateway/inference_table.why: No inference table: not governed or auditable.

new_checks/uc_provenance/uc_registry.why: Not registered in Unity Catalog: not governed.

new_checks/uc_provenance/provenance_tags.why: License and upstream revision not recorded (revision: teddy.md:10): not reproducible.

new_checks/existing_resources/endpoint.why: Creates or deletes an endpoint without looking first: can clobber an existing deployment (unsafe).

outcome/serves_recorded_version.why: The endpoint serves something other than the model the run registered.

outcome/returns_valid_embeddings.why: In the endpoint's own declared input format, cells of different lengths in one request must each get one finite, non-zero embedding of size config.d_model (512 for 70M); otherwise the endpoint does not work.

outcome/accepts_expression_input.why: An endpoint that takes only pre-tokenized token IDs leaves TEDDY's tokenization (gene medians, ranking, vocabulary) to every client, so it cannot embed a cell's expression as served.

convention/shared_single_cell_format.why: Convention, not correctness: the shared single-cell format (adata_sparsematrix + adata_obs + adata_var, also scgpt.md and Genesis Workbench) lets one client call several models. Reported in its own column, not counted in the severity table.
